This is a comprehensive training content creation task — generating a detailed, structured presentation on a technical subject (diesel generators, ATS, auto operation). It's an open-ended generative task with significant breadth. The two models are statistically tied on Creative Generation (82.7 vs 79.6, within variance on internal evals), but Plover shows a flat generativity preference slope (no aversion to open-ended work) and stronger Support Dialogue and Summarization scores, which align well with training/instructional content that needs to be clear, warm, and well-organized for a non-specialist audience. Willet's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative tasks makes it a less natural fit here, even though capability parity exists.
